'''Tumva''' was a [[Seanchan]] ''[[sul'dam]]''.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
== History ==
Tumva captured [[Megda]], an [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Falme]], at the time of the Seanchan invasion of the city, and trained her as ''[[damane]]''.<ref name="RPG"/>
